By evaluating plausible monoisotopic combinations of C, H, O and a single other element (X), the formula C₅H₁₄N₂O₂ matches this exact mass within ~30 ppm, which is the best fit among reasonable candidates.</thought>
<final_answer>C5H14N2O2</final_answer>
